newsitem.title: USA: Casing being run in UNEXCO, Edge well.
newsitem.headline: Casing being run in UNEXCO, Edge well.

text.p: UNEXCO Inc said Monday production casing is being run in the Edge Petroleum Operating Co No. 1 W.G. Schmidt et al well in Victoria County, Texas, which encountered 18 feet of pay in a "Frio" age sand from 3838-56 feet.
Additionally, several other sands appear productive from log and side-wall core analysis, the Universal Seismic Associates Inc energy subsidiary said.
UNEXCO has a 50 percent working interest in the well, as does Edge Petroleum Corp EPEX.O.

UNEXCO also said an engineering study of the Lake Boeuf Project, a 28,398 square mile 3-D seismic program scheduled for completion in March, established proven undeveloped reserves of 6.6 billion cubic feet of natural gas and 199,500 barrels of oil for a single fault block within the area.

UNEXCO has a 37.5 percent working interest in the project. According to the engineering study, net to UNEXCO's interest, the present value of the potential reserves discounted at eight percent is $2.2 million.
